items.title: Pete Levin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: a lot of great soloists were in that band... Johnny Coles... I think was in the band at that point.

ctx.x: Even back then, I don’t remember how big the band was, probably fourteen or fifteen guys in it, a lot of great soloists were in that band, guys who have been heavy influences © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-

on the jazz scene going way back: Howard Johnson, Johnny Coles, Jimmy Knepper I think was in the band at that point. I don’t remember whether Dave Sanborn was playing — no that came a little bit later. Lenny White was the drummer at that point and Herb Bushler was playing bass.
